title: What happened in AI — Oct 15, 2026
intro: Agent builders got concrete guidance on evals and bounded autonomy from LangChain, AWS and Anthropic, while LangChain and Modal showed the tooling and sandbox layer maturing.
Meta's open-weights release and vLLM's day-0 Nemotron support moved the serving story, and DeepSeek's second major outage was a reminder to plan for provider failover.
highlights: LangChain answers common agent-eval questions: offline vs online, LLM judges, multi-turn, cost control.
AWS Trust in Depth: scope, know, bound, observe, prove for agent autonomy.
LangChain ships LangSmith AI Search, Trajectories and Managed Deep Agents v0.9.
Modal hits $1B ARR on a $16B Series D as sandboxes become core infra.
Meta Muse Spark Open lands as a top U.S. open-weights model; vLLM adds Nemotron 3.5 Super VL day 0.
DeepSeek down again, with refunds offered.
